selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main topic of this passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s caring mercy and giving food and needs to living things.

questions.question: Which group is cared for in a very special way?
questions.answer: The weak, helpless, and young.

questions.question: Which creatures are especially pointed out as needing care?
questions.answer: The weak, powerless, and young.

questions.question: What does the verse about every creature on earth teach?
questions.answer: Every creature depends on Allah for its food and needs.

questions.question: According to the passage, who alone has the job of giving provision?
questions.answer: Allah alone.

questions.question: What truth do the Qur’an verses repeat in different ways?
questions.answer: Allah alone provides sustenance.

questions.question: Who especially needs this reminder about provision?
questions.answer: People who think causes are the real reason things are given.

questions.question: Which wrong belief is the passage warning against?
questions.answer: Thinking causes themselves are the real providers.

questions.question: What example helps us imagine Allah’s care for very hidden creatures?
questions.answer: He provides even for creatures on the ocean floor and their young.

questions.question: Why is giving food in an orderly and timely way amazing?
questions.answer: Because so many different creatures get what they need without mix-up or delay.

questions.question: What truth is named in this passage?
questions.answer: The truth of mercy and giving provision.

questions.question: To how much of the world does this care reach?
questions.answer: It reaches all over the world.

questions.question: How far does Allah’s providing reach, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Everywhere in the world.

questions.question: Whose hand is said to do this, even though it is not seen?
questions.answer: Allah’s power gives it, though people do not see Him.

questions.question: Why is getting food from dry ground and hard wood a sign of Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Because life-giving food comes from things that seem unable to make it.

questions.question: What do the Qur’an verses in the passage help prove?
questions.answer: That Allah alone is the true Provider.

questions.question: What does the third Qur’an verse say about animals that do not store food?
questions.answer: Allah still provides for them and for people too.

questions.question: Who receives provision even if they cannot gather it themselves?
questions.answer: Weak creatures and animals.

questions.question: What unusual example shows Allah’s care reaches hidden places?
questions.answer: He feeds creatures at the bottom of the sea and their babies.

questions.question: What big idea do these proofs support?
questions.answer: One merciful Provider takes care of every living being.

questions.question: What is being given to living creatures in this passage?
questions.answer: Their needed provision.

questions.question: Does the passage speak about only people, or about all animate beings?
questions.answer: It speaks about all animate beings.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about who really gives provision?
questions.answer: Allah is the real Provider.

questions.question: What does the passage say about mistakes in this giving?
questions.answer: There are no omissions or mix-ups.
